content_html:
Legal • Openink Hub

A short, plain-language look at how we use cookies.

This Cookie Policy explains what cookies and similar tracking technologies Openink Hub uses on openinkhub.io, why we use them, and how you can control them.

Effective date

14 July 2026

Website

openinkhub.io

Contact

info@openinkhub.io

Section 1

What cookies are, and why we use them

Cookies are small data files placed on your device when you visit a website, used to make the site work and to help us understand how it's used.

First-party

Set by Openink Hub

Cookies set directly by us to run the site and remember your session.

Third-party

Set by our partners

Cookies set by other providers we work with — for things like analytics, interactive content, or advertising.

Some cookies are strictly necessary for the site to function; others help us understand and improve how visitors use our automation platforms and marketing pages.

Section 2

The cookies we use

A. Essential

Strictly necessary

Needed to deliver core site features like secure areas, dashboard logins, and subscription management. Because they're essential, they can't be switched off without affecting how the site works.

B. Performance & analytics

Understanding usage

Powered by tools like Google Analytics, these help us see how the site is used and how well our SEO workflows and automation platforms are performing, in aggregate.

C. Functionality

Remembering preferences

Non-essential cookies that remember your preferences, preferred language, or layout choices across our client portal.

D. Targeting & advertising

Relevant ads

Set through tools like Meta Pixel and Google Ads, these help us show relevant retargeting ads about our WhatsApp API, GMB, and SEO services, and avoid repeating the same ad too often.

Section 3

Your choices

You're in control

You can accept or decline cookies through our website's cookie consent banner, or by adjusting your browser settings directly. Declining cookies won't stop you from using the site, though some functionality and secure areas may be limited. To opt out of Google Analytics tracking across sites generally, visit Google's official opt-out page.

Consent banner Browser controls Google Analytics opt-out

Section 4

Keeping this policy current

Updates

We revisit this periodically

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the cookies we use, or for operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Check back occasionally to stay current.

Contact

Questions?

Email info@openinkhub.io or call/WhatsApp +91 9204135136. We're at 203 Liya Complex, Main Road, Ranchi, Jharkhand, India.
